verdict.rationale: Railway documents the Railway Agent, a chat-based AI assistant built into the dashboard. It acts on the user's behalf: it creates and configures services, inspects deployments, diagnoses failures and opens fix pull requests. It can also read from connected MCP sources and be reached via @Railway in Slack. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent completes delegated tasks reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix broken builds.
If the fix is in your code, the agent can open a pull request with the change so you can review and merge it.
Mention @Railway in Slack to ask the Railway Agent about your projects, inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes without leaving the conversation.
